method: BASELINE. Written straight from the deposited text with the writing-l4-rules skill (and references/regulative.md), from the seat of the individual to whom the law is applied, with a second seat for the general health service provider, the design defaults ruled on 2026-10-18 and the rulings on negatives of 2026-11-04 and 2026-11-05 (JUST FALSE where the text says no, NOTHING with a NOTHING-kind tag where it does not answer); shared definitions, the Schedule 2 code clause by clause, one regulative rule over the provider's five duties with deadlines (ss 35, 39, 41, 52, 58) and the penalty table in a rules module, the questions in two seat modules importing it; the regulative rule run by EVALTRACE inside an exported question that takes only plain facts; no REFUSE; checked with the stable l4 of VS Code extension 1.6.98, JL4_LIBRARY_PATH unset. No pipeline, no coverage table, no independent test pass, no human gate.

seats: the person who complains: the person who received or sought the health service, another person complaining about a service to them (s 6), or their carer (s 7) (hca-seat.l4)
the general health service provider: a person providing a health service that is not the practice of a National Law health profession (hca-seat-provider.l4)

checks.note: l4 run exits 0 even when an assertion fails, so the diagnostics are what was read. Expected values worked by hand from the text.
